touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Wroxeter qualifies as a local detour through Wroxeter Roman Site Museum and Wroxeter Roman City Museum. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Wroxeter: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Wroxeter offers Wroxeter Roman Site Museum, Wroxeter Roman City Museum, CHURCH OF ST ANDREW within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Wroxeter Roman Site Museum
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Wroxeter Roman Site Museum and Wroxeter Roman City Museum, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
